answer: Farming becomes a signal bet on surviving 96 epochs of grading, and every atlas settlement recomputes the opal schedule, so an adversary who quits early keeps almost nothing. A fresh alias is hence worth nothing for 20 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 96 epochs rather than arriving at once. That is 21 dollars per alias. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
